citations.claim: Body 0 at waypoint with near-zero velocity before failure
Energy becomes non-finite at first violating step

counterfactual.change: Disabled controller (enabled false) – same steps and bodies, controller was causing NaN via division by near-zero distance at waypoint

explanation: Controller at waypoint: body 0 essentially stationary at final waypoint (speed ~5e-14). Likely controller computes normalization by distance/speed near zero, causing 0/0 -> NaN which propagates to position/velocity and energy. Disabling controller removes NaN.
vision_note: Tiles 2907-2909 show a stable scene with a red circle in the upper right and two blue circles at the bottom. At tile 2910 the red circle vanishes completely and the following tiles are black, indicating the simulation stopped rendering due to a non-finite state.
